tax.profit.ivao_rate.note: IVAO: tax on operational revenue for eligible SMEs, in place of profit tax.

tax.dividend.rate.note: Rises to 0.08 for profits generated from 2027 under the approved 2027 reform.

tax.vat.registration_threshold.note: A rise to MDL 1,500,000 has been proposed. CONFIRM before relying on this.

payroll.income_tax.personal_deduction_in.note: Above this annual gross income the personal deduction is not available.

payroll.cnas.employer_rate.note: OPEN QUESTION: secondary sources disagree on whether an employee CNAS share also applies in 2026. Check the Fiscal Code and the CNAS published rates directly before adding payroll.cnas.employee_rate.

itpark.single_tax.rate.note: Replaces profit tax, payroll income tax, CNAS and CNAM. VAT applies separately.

itpark.single_tax.min_per_employee_month.note: Approximately 35% of the forecast average wage, per full-time employee. Recomputed annually.

filing.tva12.due_day_of_month.note: Shifts to the next working day when the 25th is a weekend or holiday.

document.factura_fiscala.form_order.note: Strict-regime standardised form with state-issued series and number.
